rights.note: Pneuma's own 牛马 mascot: the front view of modes/anime-series/seed/guang-niuma/refs/char-niuma-sheet-2.webp, redrawn as a flat sticker character

character.description: a round chubby pale blue-grey ox calf with no visible neck, small rounded ears, two short cream horns, a single curl of hair on top of the head, big droopy dark eyes under worried brows, a wide cream muzzle with two small nostrils, a thin mint-green collar with a small square cream tag showing a tiny ox face, short stubby legs with dark grey hooves
character.style: thick clean dark outlines, flat colors

wechat.name: 打工牛马
wechat.intro: 上班的牛马替你回工作群：收到、马上、稍等、辛苦了，还有加班、摸鱼、下班啦和不想上班。

line.title: 打工牛马 Work Ox
line.creator: Pneuma
line.description: 打工牛马的一天：收到、马上、稍等、辛苦了、加班中、摸鱼、下班啦、不想上班。

stickers.caption: 收到
stickers.action: stands up straight, gives one firm nod, raises its right front hoof to its brow in a crisp salute, holds it for a beat, then lowers it back to the start pose

stickers.caption: 马上
stickers.action: runs in place at full speed facing the viewer, short legs pumping, body leaning forward, a determined frown and one sweat drop flying off its head

stickers.caption: 稍等
stickers.action: holds one front hoof up toward the viewer in a 'wait a moment' gesture, head tilted with an apologetic grin, bobbing gently twice

stickers.caption: 辛苦了
stickers.action: presses its two front hooves together, bows deeply with eyes closed and a grateful smile, holds the bow for a beat, then straightens up

stickers.caption: 加班中
stickers.action: sits slumped with heavy half-closed eyes and dark rings under them, its head slowly droops forward, jerks back up with wide startled eyes, then starts drooping again

stickers.caption: 摸鱼
stickers.action: hugs a small blue fish to its chest and strokes it with one hoof, a sly content grin, eyes darting left then right to check that no one is watching

stickers.caption: 下班啦
stickers.action: jumps straight up with both front hooves thrown in the air and a huge open-mouthed grin, lands, and jumps again

stickers.caption: 不想上班
stickers.action: lies on its back on the ground, kicking all four short legs and bawling, big streams of cartoon tears flying from its eyes
